Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.datatables.adapter

package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.datatables.adapter
The DataTables ↔ BeanQuery adapter.

Kept separate from org.apache.juneau.rest.server.datatables, which holds only the DataTables JSON input/output beans. DataTablesQuery maps a DataTablesRequest onto a BeanQuery, runs it against a BeanQuerySession, and populates a DataTablesResults envelope.

Since:
10.0.0
